name: Hearth pork belly
summary: Pork belly smoked on the hearth. Báo Sơn La, on 1 April 2022, names ba chỉ hun khói beside buffalo. On 15 May 2025 the same paper names ba chỉ gác bếp as a further product of a Chiềng Cơi workshop, on the same marinade and the same smoke as the buffalo: 1–2 hours in mắc khén, garlic, ginger, and chili, then about 6–8 hours. Both names stay.
origin: Báo Sơn La, 1 April 2022 and 15 May 2025.
howToEat: As the smoked belly, or carry it. A price and an hour are Check on arrival.
where: Phường Chiềng Cơi, on the 15 May 2025 account. The 2022 account does not name a ward.
seoTitle: Ba chi gac bep in Son La — hearth pork belly
seoDescription: Ba chỉ gác bếp, also called ba chỉ hun khói, in Sơn La. Báo Sơn La puts it on the Chiềng Cơi hearth smoke. A price is Check on arrival.
